name: swinsian-player
title: Swinsian Player
description: Control Swinsian from Raycast. Play, pause, skip tracks, set ratings, search your library, and see what's playing in your menu bar.
author: deathrashed

preferences.name: libraryDatabasePath
preferences.title: Swinsian Library Database
preferences.description: Optional override for Swinsian's Library.sqlite file. Leave empty to use the standard Application Support location.

preferences.name: libraryRoot
preferences.title: Music Folder
preferences.description: Optional root music folder shown in Browse Library for quick Finder access. Browsing data comes from Swinsian's database above.

preferences.name: toolboxHiddenCategories
preferences.title: Hidden Discovery Categories
preferences.description: Comma-separated category IDs to hide: databases, streaming, lyrics, covers, social, utilities, lastfm.
preferences.label: Hidden Categories

preferences.name: toolboxHiddenServices
preferences.title: Hidden Discovery Services
preferences.description: Comma-separated service IDs to hide. IDs are documented in the README.
preferences.label: Hidden Services

preferences.name: toolboxCustomServices
preferences.title: Custom Services
preferences.description: JSON array of custom links using {artist}, {album}, {track}, {query}, and {type} placeholders.
preferences.label: Custom Discovery Services

preferences.name: toolboxLastfmUsername
preferences.title: Last.fm Username
preferences.description: Username used by Last.fm statistics, collage, dashboard, and time-capsule services.
preferences.label: Last.fm Username

commands.name: nowPlaying
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: See what's currently playing in Swinsian. Control playback, set rating, copy info, and more.

commands.name: nowPlayingMenuBar
commands.title: Menu Bar Player
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: See what's currently playing in your Menu Bar. Click for quick controls. Refreshes every 15 seconds.

preferences.name: hideIconWhenIdle
preferences.title: Appearance
preferences.description: If enabled, the icon will be hidden when Swinsian is not running or nothing is playing
preferences.label: Hide icon when idle

preferences.name: hideArtistName
preferences.description: If enabled, the artist's name will be hidden in the Menu Bar
preferences.label: Hide artist's name

preferences.name: maxTextLength
preferences.title: Now Playing Text Length
preferences.description: Maximum number of characters to show for the currently playing track. Leave empty to use default (30).

preferences.name: showControlsSection
preferences.title: Menu Sections
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of the playback controls section in the menu bar player
preferences.label: Show Controls

preferences.name: showModesSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of the playback modes (repeat/shuffle) section
preferences.label: Show Playback Options

preferences.name: showVolumeSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of the volume controls section
preferences.label: Show Volume Controls

preferences.name: showDiscoverySection
preferences.title: Action Sections
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of web discovery shortcuts in the menu bar player
preferences.label: Show Discovery

preferences.name: showCopySection
preferences.description: Toggle metadata, files, Last.fm tools, and bundled reports in the menu bar player
preferences.label: Show Tools

preferences.name: showLastfmSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of Love in Now Playing and Ban in Playback
preferences.label: Show Last.fm Controls

preferences.name: showOutputSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of the audio device inspector shortcut
preferences.label: Show Device Inspector

preferences.name: showWindowsSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of Swinsian windows and utility shortcuts
preferences.label: Show Options

preferences.name: showLibrarySection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of the library management actions
preferences.label: Show Library Maintenance

preferences.name: showOpenCommandsSection
preferences.description: Toggle the visibility of shortcuts that open full Raycast library and playlist commands
preferences.label: Show Raycast

commands.name: libraryBrowser
commands.title: Browse Library
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: Navigate Swinsian hierarchically by artist, album artist, album, genre, or year. Artist results open albums, then tracks.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Quick Search
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: Quickly find tracks across titles, artists, and albums, then play the selected result.

commands.name: playlists
commands.title: Browse Playlists
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: Browse and play your Swinsian playlists.

commands.name: addToPlaylist
commands.title: Add Track to Playlist
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: Choose a playlist and add the current Swinsian track to it.

commands.name: togglePlayPause
commands.title: Play/Pause
commands.subtitle: Swinsian
commands.description: Toggle the playback of the current track.
